description: This file is a header (.h) file defining exported API functions for the Beep Master Host Object within the BSP environment, including function prototypes for creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization of the object.

methods.name: BeepCreateMasterHost
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Beep Master Host Object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: BeepMhoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Beep Master Host Object with specified contexts.

methods.name: BeepMhoRemove
methods.description: Removes or deletes the specified Beep Master Host Object instance.

methods.name: BeepMhoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Beep Master Host Object.

methods.name: BeepMhoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Beep Master Host Object.
